risk._block_stablecoin_buys_doc: Hard block buys of pegged bases (GUSD, USDP, USDC, DAI, …). Not volatility_tier stable. Kill: false. Enforced in risk_manager + coin_eligibility.

position_locks._doc: Per-position lock on pos.lock: default blocks auto-sell (exit_ws/trail/TA) + slot eviction. DCA and sniper stay allowed unless mode no_dca is set explicitly. Manual /sell still allowed unless no_manual_sell. Kill: enabled=false. Telegram: /lock SYMBOL [duration] [reason], /unlock SYMBOL.

moderate_deploy._rollback: enabled=false; max_open 36→24; max_usdt 4500→2500; cash_floor 12→18; cash_rich off via enabled=false.

rotation._experiment_grid_share_v1: 2026-08-10: disable grid full-close upgrades so level harvests can leave tails; trail/profit non-grid full-close stays. Kill: both true.
rotation._doc_stagnant_tier: stable-tier override, mirrors arm_gain_pct_stable. Starts equal to global default; tune with staging data.

correlated_tier._doc: Generic correlated-drawdown detector + per-group trail overlay. Kill: enabled=false (or remove a groups.<name> entry). Amplifiers default off.

oracle_climax._doc: Two-stage overlay: Oracle RISK_ON grind holds BB/TTP runners; climax stall tightens trail; 1h/15m dump harvests lots ≥12%. Fusion RISK_OFF/CRASH never sells. Disk default off — enable per tenant (Henry first). Kill: enabled=false.

path_stats._doc: Market-path episode stats in memory_path_stats. Universe: open + recent trade symbols + watchlist. Kill: enabled=false or MEMORY_PATH_STATS=0. Soft bias (trail/arm) is separate under soft_bias.

soft_bias._doc: Soft trail/arm bias for open positions when quality=ok. Same kill as path_stats. Never flips floor_at_entry/arm_on_peak. soft_bias.enabled=false keeps stats write/read without exit bias.

path_stats._rollback: MEMORY_PATH_STATS=0 or enabled=false (kills write+bias); soft_bias.enabled=false (bias only); optional drop collection memory_path_stats

trailing_stop._doc: stop=max(entry, peak*(1-trail)). arm_on_peak sticky. Prevents LAB-class free-fall past entry after a real peak (needs continuous eval).

trailing_take_profit._doc: priority 7 > TS 6. trail_above_zero_after_arm: take peak giveback while still green.

dca._loss_pct_min_doc: Configured floor only. evaluate extends to -stop_loss_pct; sl_proximity still blocks the last band. Kill: set loss_pct_min more negative than SL.

stable_altcoin._bb_sell_min_gain_pct_doc: Block bb_upper micro sells on stable/grid lots (e.g. TAO +0.1%). Volatile stays at 12. Kill: 0.

mid_cap_defaults._bb_sell_min_gain_pct_doc: Align mid-cap structure sells with stable floor; no sub-2% bb_upper full/partial noise.

dynamic_social._doc: Raise CMC/Santiment/Lunar weight only when ≥2 agree (not always). Quotes-BUY 88% + RISK_ON is a chorus. Lunar joins if enabled. Kill: enabled=false.

strategy_allocator._experiment_grid_share_v1: 2026-08-10: weight 0.6→0.4 so RANGING stable tends HYBRID not pure GRID. Kill: 0.6/0.4.

sell_policy._min_sell_gain_pct_doc: Block pure grid level harvests below this gain % vs entry (plus green_buffer_pct). Staging: 1.0 stops sub-1% micro closes. Kill: 0.0.

ws_board._doc: GIS-14+: REST seeds watch set; Gate WS ticks rank top gainers → logs/gainer_ws_board.jsonl. No auto-buy. Kill: enabled=false.

gainer_universe._experiment_gainer_catch_v1: 2026-08-10: inject 12→25, trade_max_with_expand 50→60, heat_max 40→45. Klasse A bandwidth only. Kill: 12/50/40.
gainer_universe._experiment: GIS-14 Gate Identify & Sell (virtual); rollback: expand_inject_max 12, live_top_n 50, heat 12-40, ws_board.enabled false

gainer_entry._doc: Gainer nominates only. require_de_confirm=true → DecisionEngine (TA + personal recipes) must BUY; memory/risk still apply. Kill: enabled=false or GAINER_ENTRY_ENABLED=0. require_de_confirm=false restores raw rank-buy (not recommended).

gainer_relvol_shadow._doc: RelVol via gainer-signal REST+WS. Bot enforces mode=trade, separate caps, already_open, extension max_pct_24h, fail-closed size. Kill bot: mode=shadow|off. Kill signal svc: GAINER_RELVOL_ENABLED=0 or GAINER_RELVOL_MODE=shadow.

gainer_signal._doc: Signal service policy. fixed_v0=global 12-40; coin_aware_v1=vol-bucket bands + rank quality + hard_ceiling. Env GAINER_ENTRY_POLICY overrides. Rollback: entry_policy fixed_v0.

exit_rotation._rollback: Set enabled=false or profile=base to restore pre-rotation TTP/lifetime knobs without code revert. gainer: enabled=false or mode=off. Issue #162 flags under gainer_universe. moderate_deploy: risk.moderate_deploy.enabled=false; universe.trade_max_coins 58→40.

exit_realtime._doc: Gate WS trail TP/stop → TradingService SELL. owner=bot (in-process) | sidecar (xagent-exit-radar). Kill: enabled=false. Epic #178 / #190.
exit_realtime._rollback: owner=bot + enabled=false on sidecar; or enabled=false → cycle-only exits
exit_realtime._sidecar: Set owner=sidecar + EXIT_EXECUTE_URL + EXIT_WS_INTERNAL_TOKEN on both services
